scorers-table design system

Generated by scripts/build_design_system.py from assets/css/* and scripts/design_system/*. Six layouts, each in light and dark, phone width (390 px). All leagues, teams and people are made up. Frames force a theme with data-theme; a real page follows the phone's setting until the visitor presses the sun/moon button.

Theme button

44 px round button: the moon (page is light, switches to dark) and the sun (page is dark, switches to light). The label names the action and changes with the page, so no aria-pressed.

League colour

Each layout with a league's own colour: an inline --st-league-color plus the data-league-colour attribute on the layout wrapper, which is exactly what stage 4 will write. Four of the eight example colours are shown (the others are in the matrix in docs/contrast.md): Navy, Deep red, Forest green, Teal, Purple, Brown and Mid blue pass every checked pair in every layout, light and dark. Gold fails on purpose: white text on it is 2.9:1, and stage 4's data check would stop with a message naming the league's colour.
